front: Against a 3% target, return shortfalls are 4%, 2%, and 0% across four observations. Using the sample target-semideviation convention, the result is closest to:

front: Fund A has mean 8% and standard deviation 12%; Fund B has mean 5% and standard deviation 6%. Which has lower relative dispersion?
back: Coefficient of variation is standard deviation divided by mean; lower positive CV means less dispersion per unit of mean, but near-zero or negative means impair interpretation.
